title: Evidence-Backed Assurance Package Foundation
goal: Prepare the first responsible assurance package output that summarizes scoped validation without overclaiming security certainty.
scope: Define and implement a first assurance-package report surface using existing evidence, methodology, scope, finding, remediation, retest, and report provenance. The output must state what was tested, what remains unresolved, and what is out of scope.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Build an honest assurance package only. Do not imply hack-proof, full compliance attestation, or absence of all risk.
notes: Every assurance statement must be traceable to scope, evidence, or methodology.
Unresolved findings and out-of-scope items must remain visible.

success_criteria: A first assurance-package report variant or documented output path exists.
The package includes engagement, scope, methodology, evidence references, findings, residual risk, and out-of-scope wording.
Forbidden overclaim language is avoided in generated copy.
Markdown, HTML, and PDF behavior is validated if a report variant is implemented.
must_not_touch: pack registry and runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Assurance output is evidence-backed and scoped.
Unresolved and out-of-scope items are explicit.
No generated wording claims absolute security or compliance certification beyond evidence.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Allowed and forbidden assurance wording is documented before report output is finalized.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with assurance-package changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the assurance output baseline and remaining certification limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
